caption: The drawing depicts two wooden boot lasts positioned side by side, both with a pair of crossed wood arms attached to their tops. The wood is rendered in shades of brown with visible grain patterns, and the arms are joined to the lasts with metal screws. One of the lasts is equipped with a black leather strap and a metallic buckle, which lies coiled on the white surface beneath it. The background is plain and unadorned, off-white in color, and there are small, subtle spots or stains scattered sparsely across the page. The artist's signature, "Frank E. Brane," is located in the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Saddle
